methods.name: Season-matched radar–optical change classification
methods.why: Compare 2018 and 2023 using identical seasonal windows, reference samples and area-adjusted error estimates.

methods.name: Biomass modeling and uncertainty propagation
methods.why: Use lidar and available plots to constrain carbon estimates; report uncertainty and 2023 extrapolation rather than treating radar as direct carbon measurement.

methods.name: Peat carbon scenarios
methods.why: Combine peat extent, thickness and locally sourced carbon density; avoid inferring change from a static layer.

Check 2023 biomass availability and report peat carbon change as unresolved if repeat soil data are absent.

methods.why: Combine peat extent, thickness and locally sourced carbon density; avoid inferring change from a static layer.
